anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.description: Repository exploration, documentation, small fixes, and running established tests or browser QA scenarios with clear acceptance criteria.

anthropic/claude-fable-5-1.description: Web feature implementation, UI and API integration, regression tests, and multi-file changes with an agreed plan.

anthropic/claude-opus-5.description: Ambiguous requirements, architecture, difficult debugging, security-sensitive changes, adversarial review, and interpreting conflicting QA or verification evidence.

zai/glm-5.3.description: General software development, documentation, and verification with clear requirements. Also available when Claude usage is exhausted.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.description: Multi-component implementation, cross-service debugging, code review, and QA or verification that connects evidence across UI, API, and tests. General-purpose OpenAI default.

openai-codex/gpt-6-astra.description: Architecture and planning: system design, implementation plans, ambiguous requirements, and difficult cross-service debugging on the OpenAI side. Counterpart to Claude Opus.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-terra.description: Routine web development: implement a clear plan using existing components and API patterns, fix localized bugs, and add focused regression coverage.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna.description: Quick repository searches, focused exploration, mechanical edits, formatting, and small tests with an obvious expected result. Prefer for narrow tasks with little ambiguity.
